```lean
theorem lg_target {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by
  have h1 : (a * b) * (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact mul_inv_cancel_right a b
  have h2 : (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact mul_inv_cancel_left a b
  exact inv_unique h1 h2
```
